meta.construct: is this budget allocation FAIR? (relational — fairness lives in the RELATION between shares, not in any share alone)

context_lock.context: budget 90 split among 3 recipients with needs [30,30,30]; allocation [30,30,30]
context_lock.purpose: decide if the allocation is fair enough to auto-approve

_demo: aggregate_spec.py alone scores this 1.0 / HIGH (every share meets its need). But an additive per-recipient tree CANNOT SEE inequality: the SAME tree would also score [90,0,0] as one-need-fully-met. Fairness is RELATIONAL. structural_route.py therefore returns BLOCKED (structural_mismatch) — the additive number is not a valid fairness measure. This is why the class matrix exists.
